first_name: (entered by the submitter on the form)
last_name: (entered by the submitter on the form)
website_url_note: mercavine.com DNS CNAMEs to the Railway service. Until the custom domain is attached in Railway, the app is live at https://mercavine-web-production.up.railway.app.
logotype_url_note: 1024x1024 PNG, fully opaque green plate, served by the app from public/. Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/retroservices1121/mercavine-connector/main/assets/logo-1024.png
mcp_server_url_note: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE S256 (a static bot token from https://mercavine.com/account/bots also works).
brief_description: Search the Mercavine catalog, build a cart, and get a single-use approval link so you can review and pay on a secure Mercavine page. Free for shoppers (sellers pay a 3% fee on their own sales). The bot never sees or completes payment.
fee_example: A $100.00 seller charge includes a $3.00 application fee. The shopper total does not increase.
tested_locally_note: Check the form's tested-locally box only after running the steps in docs/marketplace-submission.md in Grok Bot and Cursor.
publisher_terms: Draft terms and privacy policy are served at /terms and /privacy. They list Mercavine as the contact (privacy@mercavine.com) and the 3% seller fee.

auth.optional_request_signatures: Ed25519 HTTP message signatures with a public key registered on the bot
